summary: Ran prettier, svelte-autofixer, pnpm check, and the router test suite to verify Skills toggle behavior, capturing 0 errors. Took mobile-viewport Edge screenshots of /#/settings/skills, then iterated on settings.css (adding box-sizing: border-box, removing flex-wrap, setting grid width to calc(100vw - 32px)) to fix header action clipping in the skills workbench layout on narrow viewports.
decisions: Add `box-sizing: border-box` to the skills settings-content so padding doesn't push beyond the 680px width cap
Drop `flex-wrap: wrap` on `[data-ui='settings-page-actions']` within the skills page
Set the skills workbench grid to `width: calc(100vw - 32px)` with `minmax(0, 1fr)` columns to prevent overflow on ~430px mobile viewports
